latestVersion.changelog:
From Video Online — v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for downloading and saving online videos (e.g., from YouTube) and exporting them as MP4 and other formats
- Handles video downloads, uploads, export, editing, and state management all via cloud GPU processing with session-based workflow
- Anonymous, automatic account creation and authentication with free credits for new users
- Supports uploading and exporting video in a variety of formats up to 500MB, with credit and error handling built-in
- User-friendly prompt-based instructions and real-time status updates for all processing steps
